title: Modify Sword Template
description: A simple template pack for the Modify Networks custom items.
body:
## ModifyNetwork custom sword resoruce pack.
This is the offical template pack for the Modify Network swords.

- Please follow our rules which you can find in [our Discord](https://discord.com/invite/modify).

- Version 1.21.8 is recommended for the optimal experience.

- This pack is designed for you to edit the textures/models easly.

- A list of model data strings can be found in [our Discord](https://discord.com/invite/modify) in [this Discord channel](https://discord.com/channels/1256445451994136606/1524014034934956143) for easy pack making/editing.

_We do not represent or claim to be affiliated with Minecraft, Mojang or Microsoft._
